system.description:
You create a vortex of ferocious wind 15-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder centering on you. When a creature other than you enters the jutsu's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, they are pushed by the pressure and must make a Strength saving throw. If taking 3d6 wind damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. Creatures inside the radius of this jutsu are heavily obscured from creatures who aren't and vice versa.

Critical Success: Affected creatures take half of 3d6 wind damage.

Success: Affected creatures takes half of 3d6 wind damage and becomes Bruised.

Failure: Affected creatures takes 3d6 wind damage, is Bruised and are pushed back 10-feet.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but affected creatures take 5d6 wind damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or Higher, you can see through this obstruction. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank or higher, you reduce the damage of ranged attacks targeting you by 3d6 and this jutsu gains the Barrier keyword.
